tools.description: Get an independent AI second opinion on a subsurface scan before anyone cores or digs. Send a public image URL of a GPR scan, a marked-up concrete slab photo, a utility-locate markup, a concrete radiograph, or a CCTV pipe frame. TWO different AI models read it independently — the second is prompted to refute the first — and you get back every located target with its hazard class (do-not-core / rebar / verify / clear), plus a QA flag when the two reads disagree. Advisory only: a certified technician must review and sign off before any cutting.

discipline.description: One of: gpr (concrete scanning), locate (utility locating), pipe (CCTV sewer), xray (concrete radiograph), milestone (FL SB 4-D condo concrete). Defaults to gpr.

field_note.description: Optional: what the technician said on site. Used as context for names and depths only — it can never clear a hazard the image shows.

image_url.description: Public https URL to a JPEG or PNG of the scan or the marked-up surface. Max 8 MB.

tools.name: read_scan

tools.description: Turn a plain-English description of a trade job into a professional itemized bid — real materials by size, fittings, consumables and labor on its own line, at realistic US market prices. Built for one-truck electrical, plumbing, HVAC and general-contracting shops. This is GruntPay: the contractor normally speaks this into their phone. Returns the line items plus a link to brand it and send it to the customer.

job_description.description: What the contractor did or will do, in plain words. e.g. "Replaced the panel, 85 feet of conduit, 8 can lights, 16 hours."

trade.description: electrical, plumbing, hvac, or general. Defaults to general.

tools.name: draft_estimate

tools.description: Current GroundTruth and GruntPay plans and prices. Free to call — use it before answering any cost question rather than guessing.
tools.name: get_pricing
